nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: Room tiles size to min-content (1.4.8)
nodes.rationale: A Reddit user compared the dashboard side-by-side with Dwains Dashboard: a room with one light was rendered the same 190px-tall tile as a room with six devices, because [data-r="rooms"] split leftover flex space evenly across rows. Switching to grid-auto-rows:min-content lets each row size to its own content; rooms.max default raised 8->12 since rows no longer need a fixed height to look intentional.

nodes.label: Seven new discovered domains (1.4.8)
nodes.rationale: humidifier, lock, water_heater, valve, lawn_mower, siren each need their own busy/active semantics (e.g. a lock is 'active' when unlocked, a siren when sounding) rather than a generic on/off inverse.

nodes.label: Room status pills for binary_sensor classes (1.4.8)
nodes.rationale: door/window/opening/garage_door, motion/occupancy/presence, moisture/smoke/gas pills only appear when the sensor is actually 'on' since a closed door is the normal state and shouldn't be noise.
nodes.norm_label: room status pills for binary_sensor classes (1.4.8)

nodes.label: Battery pill only under 20% (1.4.8)
nodes.rationale: A charged battery isn't news, so the pill is suppressed above the threshold; room cards cap at four pills in priority order.

nodes.label: Switch wattage inline display (1.4.8)
nodes.rationale: A switch on the same device as a device_class:power sensor shows instantaneous wattage inline, reusing the same device-to-entity relationship already used for cameras and their motion sensor; voltage/current/energy sensors remain deliberately never shown.

nodes.label: Energy tab empty on zero-config installs (1.4.7)
nodes.rationale: Reported on Reddit: 'On the homescreen I see the solar but not on the energy tab.' Instant-power (kW) cells only ever come from config.energy — energy/get_prefs and auto-discovery both resolve energy (kWh) counters, not power — so zero-config installs saw a blank header instead of falling back to the ring/totals the home screen already resolved.
nodes.norm_label: energy tab empty on zero-config installs (1.4.7)

nodes.label: Trend chart message instead of flat zero bars (1.4.7)
nodes.rationale: A flat row of zero-height bars read as 'you produce nothing' rather than 'no data yet'; replaced with a plain message when the chosen period has no data for any series.
nodes.norm_label: trend chart message instead of flat zero bars (1.4.7)

nodes.label: Card shadows clipped at page edges fixed (1.4.6)
nodes.rationale: Root container padding (16px/18px) was smaller than the neumorphic shadow's reach (up to 22px), so cards flush against the page edge had their shadow clipped by overflow:hidden. Padding raised to 22px/24px to match the shadow reach; mobile was unaffected since its page isn't clipped.
nodes.norm_label: card shadows clipped at page edges fixed (1.4.6)

nodes.label: Compact Fotovoltaico card hid energy values with cameras (1.4.5)
nodes.rationale: The compact layout used whenever cameras are configured swapped the three-line legend for a one-line summary, dropping the values from the markup entirely. Replaced with three small tiles under the ring.
nodes.norm_label: compact fotovoltaico card hid energy values with cameras (1.4.5)

nodes.label: Energy chart colors corrected to match ring grammar (1.4.5)
nodes.rationale: The Energy view's chart colored production/grid import opposite to the home-screen ring (sage=solar, terracotta=grid there, reversed in the chart). Fixed alongside adding the fed-to-grid bar since correcting one without the other would leave the two views agreeing on nothing.
nodes.norm_label: energy chart colors corrected to match ring grammar (1.4.5)

nodes.label: Third chart bar for energy fed to grid (1.4.5)
nodes.rationale: Added next to production and grid import in both desktop and mobile stick-chart — the daily total the ring already tracks but the trend chart never showed. Installs without an export sensor keep the original two-bar layout.
nodes.norm_label: third chart bar for energy fed to grid (1.4.5)

nodes.label: Duplicate appliance loop on mobile fixed (1.4.4)
nodes.rationale: dash_neumo_mobile.html had two identical loops over the appliance list, a copy-paste leftover the desktop layout never had, causing every appliance to render twice inside its room card.
nodes.norm_label: duplicate appliance loop on mobile fixed (1.4.4)

nodes.label: Removed unreliable 'N min remaining' appliance text (1.4.4)
nodes.rationale: Home Assistant integrations report a washer/dryer remaining-time sensor inconsistently (units, absolute vs relative), risking nonsense like '2026 min remaining'. Rather than per-integration guessing, the appliance card now shows only its state label while running; the remaining config field, i18n string, and demo sensor were removed.
nodes.norm_label: removed unreliable 'n min remaining' appliance text (1.4.4)

nodes.label: Support HA's flat grid energy schema (1.4.3)
nodes.rationale: HA reports a grid source's import/export sensors two ways: nested under flow_from/flow_to (handled since 1.4.1) or directly on the source (stat_energy_from at top level, unhandled until now). Both are now read equally, deduplicated if reported both ways.
nodes.norm_label: support ha's flat grid energy schema (1.4.3)

nodes.label: Diagnostic log lists found field names on unrecognized source (1.4.3)
nodes.rationale: The '[live_dashboard] energia' diagnostic log now lists field names found on an unrecognized source, so a future unhandled shape is diagnosable at a glance instead of just 'not found'.
nodes.norm_label: diagnostic log lists found field names on unrecognized source (1.4.3)

nodes.label: Deferred src/href/points binding to avoid browser pre-fetch 404s (1.4.2)
nodes.rationale: The browser's HTML parser fetches / the instant it sees the tag, before the page's own code runs, so a literal {{ m.icon }} hole was requested as a literal URL — confirmed within ~30ms of navigation start. Every such attribute is now set after the fact via ref callback once real data exists, instead of written directly into the page markup.
nodes.norm_label: deferred src/href/points binding to avoid browser pre-fetch 404s (1.4.2)

nodes.label: Card/text readiness resolves together on first render (1.4.2)
nodes.rationale: Whether a card like Energy or the no-areas-assigned message showed up could briefly disagree with whether its text was ready, depending on exact timing of HA's next update during startup. Both now always become ready together.
nodes.norm_label: card/text readiness resolves together on first render (1.4.2)

nodes.label: energy/get_prefs sums every entry per role (1.4.1)
nodes.rationale: Auto-discovery from HA's Energy dashboard could resolve production but not grid import/export on installs with more than one solar array or grid meter/contract, because the mapping only kept the first entry per role. Now sums every entry HA reports for a role.
nodes.norm_label: energy/get_prefs sums every entry per role (1.4.1)

nodes.label: stroke-linecap:butt for near-zero ring segments (1.4.1)
nodes.rationale: stroke-linecap:round still paints a dot for a zero-length dash, causing a stray dot on the ring for a near-zero segment (e.g. feeding back a fraction of a percent). Segments this small now use stroke-linecap:butt instead.

nodes.label: console.info names which tier resolved each energy role (1.4.1)
nodes.rationale: A ring showing a wrong or missing number was previously indistinguishable from one that couldn't find its sensors at all; boot-time logging now names the tier (config.js, HA's Energy dashboard, or auto-discovery), entity/statistic, and value read for production/grid-import/grid-export.
nodes.norm_label: console.info names which tier resolved each energy role (1.4.1)

nodes.label: Fotovoltaico ring redesigned as two concentric rings (1.4.0)
nodes.rationale: The previous single ring compared today's production against today's grid import — two numbers never meant to sum to anything, so the shown percentage corresponded to no real quantity. The new ring shows two real totals: outer = house consumption (self-used solar + grid import), inner = solar production (self-used solar + fed back to grid), sharing the self-used-solar segment as the same color/starting point in both.
nodes.norm_label: fotovoltaico ring redesigned as two concentric rings (1.4.0)

nodes.label: Energy setup optional via HA Energy dashboard / auto-discovery (1.4.0)
nodes.rationale: The ring reads solar/grid sensor mapping straight from HA's own Energy dashboard when configured, falling back to a best-effort guess from device_class:energy sensors otherwise; config.js's energy block only overrides either source, explicit values always win. With no grid-export sensor anywhere, the ring falls back to the old single-ring view rather than showing an empty inner ring.
nodes.norm_label: energy setup optional via ha energy dashboard / auto-discovery (1.4.0)

nodes.label: Install-time self-check for panel_custom name/folder mismatch (1.4.0)
nodes.rationale: panel_custom's name: not matching the folder the dashboard runs from previously produced a blank/black panel with no console explanation — the single most common HACS/manual install mistake. Now prints a console.error naming the expected name: and shows the same message on the page itself.
nodes.norm_label: install-time self-check for panel_custom name/folder mismatch (1.4.0)

nodes.label: HACS support added (1.3.0)
nodes.rationale: The dashboard can be installed/updated through HACS as a custom repository, category Dashboard, alongside the existing manual install method.

nodes.label: config/www/live_dashboard_config.js survives HACS updates (1.3.0)
nodes.rationale: Placed one level up from the folder a HACS update overwrites; previous versions only supported a config.js next to the dashboard's own files, which a HACS update would wipe.

nodes.label: Example config renamed to avoid overwrite trap (1.3.1)
nodes.rationale: live_dashboard_config.example.js (was live_dashboard_config.js in 1.3.0) was always inert on its own, but sharing its name with the file a user creates in config/www/ was an easy trap: edited in place inside the plugin's own folder, it would work until the next update overwrote it.
nodes.norm_label: example config renamed to avoid overwrite trap (1.3.1)

nodes.label: Optional weather station module added (1.2.0)
nodes.rationale: config.weatherStation lets local weather station sensors take over as preferred source over the weather: entity's current-conditions attributes, adding wind/rain/irradiance/ET0/feels-like/dew point that a weather.* entity doesn't reliably expose; reuses irrigation.weather/irrigation.et0 when already set.

nodes.label: discoverRooms() excludes any config.js-referenced entity (1.1.2)
nodes.rationale: An entity already wired into a specialized module (appliance powerSwitch, irrigation valve, weather-station sensors) could also show up as a generic control or room 'environment' pill, duplicating it with unrelated context. discoverRooms() now excludes any entity referenced anywhere in config.js — one config-schema-agnostic exclusion instead of a hardcoded field list.

nodes.label: loadScript() cache-bust propagated to whole load chain (1.1.1)
nodes.rationale: dash_neumo.html/dash_neumo_mobile.html's ?v= cache-bust only ever covered the page itself; the scripts it loads (discovery.js, config.js, i18n/backend files) had none, so a browser could keep a stale discovery.js even after a fresh deploy. Every loadScript() call now reuses the page's own ?v=.
nodes.norm_label: loadscript() cache-bust propagated to whole load chain (1.1.1)

nodes.label: Appliances module added (1.1.0)
nodes.rationale: config.appliances shows washer/dryer-style status (running state, remaining minutes, energy today) for setups where a plain switch isn't enough. Explicit config since no HA domain standardizes it, like Vehicle. A powerSwitch on an appliance stops being auto-discovered as a plain toggle so it isn't shown twice.

nodes.label: data-sel selected state fixed with !important (1.0.1)
nodes.rationale: [data-sel="true"] was completely inert wherever a button's own inline style also set background/box-shadow/color, since inline styles always win over a stylesheet rule regardless of specificity — on mobile's mode buttons this meant zero visible difference between active and inactive. Fixed with !important, plus a soft tinted background added for readability.

nodes.label: Empty-state guidance when zero HA areas exist (1.0.0)
nodes.rationale: A message and direct link to Settings -> Areas replaces a silently blank Stanze section — the single most likely reason a fresh install would look broken on first load.
nodes.norm_label: empty-state guidance when zero ha areas exist (1.0.0)

nodes.label: Irrigation timed watering via input_button (0.3.0)
nodes.rationale: Found validating against a real installation whose zones are opened by a script/automation already owning the timing, with no switch entity to drive directly. buttons (one input_button.* per duration) takes over from valve when both are set.

nodes.label: panel.js registers <folder>-panel tag from deploy folder (0.2.1)
nodes.rationale: panel.js previously registered a hardcoded casa-panel tag regardless of the deploy folder or configuration.yaml's name:, so any install with a different name loaded blank/black with no console error. The tag is now derived from the module's own deploy folder, so two installs can run side by side without a customElements.define() collision.
nodes.norm_label: panel.js registers <folder>-panel tag from deploy folder (0.2.1)

nodes.label: Cameras module added (0.2.0)
nodes.rationale: Auto-discovered Surveillance tab (from 2+ cameras), featured-camera card in Casa, snapshot previews on a timer paused while hidden, tap-to-live MJPEG fullscreen with 2-minute auto-close, and hideUntilTap privacy mode; motion read from any binary_sensor with device_class:motion on the same device.

nodes.label: First public release (0.1.0)
nodes.rationale: Auto-discovery of rooms/people/weather/alarm/quick-actions from HA's registries; optional modules Energy, Irrigation, Vehicle each hidden until configured; demo mode with an invented dataset from file:// or ?demo; Italian/English UI; panel_custom the only supported install method.
